diagnosis.statement: Seregin's Euler scaling gives physical spatial extent lambda*a but time depth lambda^2*nu*a^2. A physical unit-viscosity parabolic cylinder fitting inside therefore has radius at most lambda*a*sqrt(nu). Pulling A/E/D to that cylinder costs nu^(-5/2), nu^(-3/2), and nu^(-3) against the weighted prelimit ledger.
diagnosis.local_mathematical_failure: NONE: the source estimates and coordinate transforms remain valid
diagnosis.local_to_global_or_gluing_failure: YES: Euler-scaled ledger smallness does not glue directly to a physical parabolic epsilon-regularity certificate

failure.statement: Starting only from Seregin (2.9), the direct centered-cylinder covering estimate cannot force physical CKN A or E smallness at any allowed scale: F_lambda(a)<=nu^-1, while the sufficient derived E estimate would require nu^(3/2)F_lambda(a) to grow, and the A estimate would require nu^(5/2)F_lambda(a)^2 to grow.
failure.scope: direct estimate from weighted A_F/E_F/D_F ledger through maximal physical parabolic subcylinder
not_claimed: no lower bound on actual A/E/D
no impossibility of another epsilon criterion

obstruction.statement: The maximum source-valid gain F_lambda<=nu^-1 is weaker than the direct viscosity/parabolic normalization cost: E needs F beyond nu^-3/2 and A needs F beyond nu^-5/4 in the relevant F-power sense; pressure D has the same nu^-3/2 threshold in F after squaring.
applicability_conditions: direct physical parabolic CKN insertion without extra time-uniform propagation/cancellation
obstruction.difference_witness: Additional producer-specific time-uniform control, cancellation, tightness, or a different conditional regularity carrier lies outside this obstruction and may reopen the route.

candidate_lesson.statement: When an inviscid/Euler zoom makes weighted local quantities small, first price the time-aspect and viscosity normalization required by the intended parabolic consumer; scale smallness is not consumer-valid until that coordinate cost is paid.
